info.title: RelayShield Phone Reputation (Local Companion Specification)
info.description: Locally authored OpenAPI 3.1 request catalog for RelayShield POST /v1/payg/phone-reputation, listed in https://api.relayshield.net/ payg_endpoints and https://api.relayshield.net/llms.txt but omitted from the vendor OpenAPI catalog. The phone argument models the documented phone lookup and unsigned x402 v1 challenge input example; that example is not a vendor-published JSON Schema. Live challenges remain authoritative for payment.

post.summary: Check phone reputation, attack-graph pivots, SIM-swap status (24h cached), and carrier line type
post.description: Check whether a phone number appears in criminal marketplace infrastructure or pivots to known scam wallets, phishing kits, or threat actors via RelayShield's threat-intelligence corpus, and whether its SIM/eSIM was recently swapped (`signals.sim_swap`, Twilio Lookup v2, cached 24h) alongside carrier line-type intelligence (`signals.line_type`, e.g. `voip`, `mobile`, `landline`). Returns a `high`/`medium`/`unknown` verdict (`level`), `flagged` boolean, timestamped `reasons`, and structured `signals`.

200.description: Phone reputation, cached 24h SIM-swap status, line-type intelligence, and corpus sightings.

402.description: Payment required: unsigned x402 v1 challenge observed in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.
